comments.content: **`argVal` accepts flags as values**: When the matched flag is the last arg or is followed by another flag (e.g. `--cwd --product plutus`), it returns `args[i + 1]` without checking, yielding `"--product"` as the cwd. Guard against `undefined` and against values that start with `--` (which would indicate a missing value).

comments.content: **`toplevelOf` ignores `r.error` (spawn failure)**: If `git` is missing or fails to spawn, `r.status` is `null` and `r.error` holds the real reason. Returning `null` here silently disables the HOME-LEAK and PUFFER-PARENT guards. Inspect `r.error` and write it to stderr (or treat as a hard failure) so the security checks cannot be bypassed.

`run` is declared `async` but contains no `await` and calls only synchronous APIs (`spawnSync`, `process.exit`, `refuse`). Remove the `async`/Promise wrapper, or use `spawn` with `await` if true async behavior is intended. Keeping `async` misleads callers about concurrency semantics.

comments.content: **`spawnSync` has no timeout**: A hung git invocation (e.g. on a stuck NFS mount) would block the process indefinitely. Pass a `timeout` option to `spawnSync` so the dry-run plan cannot hang forever.
